intuition: The majority occurs more than all other values combined, so pairwise cancellation cannot remove every copy of it.

brute_force.approach: Count each candidate value and return one whose frequency exceeds half the array.

optimal.approach: Use Boyer-Moore voting: cancel different values and retain a candidate with a positive balance.

edge_cases: The input guarantees a majority element.
A single-element array is its own majority.
The final candidate need not be recounted because of the guarantee.
